pitch:
Gobblo (iPhone) is free forever: brain dump, 2-minute starts, feeding your pet, reminders, repeat tasks, dark mode. Nothing you need to start a task is ever locked.
Gobblo Plus is offered only after your first 7 days, so you know if the app sticks before paying. One-time $4.99, or buy single packs for $1.99 each. No subscription, no trial, ever ("Plus is yours forever" is written in the terms).
Start Kit pack: a lock-screen widget that shows your next bite and starts 2 minutes with one tap, the focus timer on your lock screen and Dynamic Island, and one-tap routine packs (morning, study, Sunday reset).
Make It Yours pack: the full closet (24 hats and accessories, 8 pet colours, 6 Home backgrounds) and 6 app themes.
Focus pack: a sound mixer with 6 soundscapes you can layer (rain + café), and your weekly "Brain Wrapped" card to share.
Every new cosmetic drop in the first year is included. Refunds go through Apple and we never fight them. Restore on any device with your Apple ID.
